label: Bible Study
prompt: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the _____ also.
verse: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
note: The sun and moon get a whole sentence; the stars get four words tacked on the end — 'he made the stars also.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of _____ fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
verse: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
note: The widow of Zarephath shared her last meal with Elijah — and her meal and oil never ran out.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock _____.
verse: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
note: 'Crew' is the old past tense of crow — Peter's third denial and the rooster's timing were exactly as Jesus foretold.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the _____, and have erred exceedingly.
verse: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
note: Saul's confession after David spared his life a second time — honest words, but it didn't last.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no _____.
verse: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
note: 'Beside me there is no saviour' — the KJV keeps the British u, and God keeps the title for himself.
